notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.12
notes.content:
[h3]Pre-release update[/h3]

[h3]News[/h3]
[list]
[*]Graphics quality settings low / medium / high
[*]Preview of full version chapters
[*]Partially playable (to the wave 33) new chapter "Scorched Earth"
[*]A player can obtain bonus coin by completing chapters, that give bonus to selected branch of towers
[*]Adjustable map view angle
[*]Short intro animation
[*]Epic hero skills
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed destroyer animation bug
[*]Some graphics improvements and UI changes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.11
notes.content:
[h3]News[/h3]
[list]
[*]Player can obtain bonus gold from starting next wave early
[*]Show info of map objects (if pointer stays on object)
[*]Towers showing special ability
[*]Changed debriefing screen
[/list]
[h3]Random encounters[/h3]
[list]
[*]Hero portal - teleports unused hero on the map
[*]Power up - adjacent towers get double bonus damage (not base damage)
[*]Old bastion - give 1.5x range bonus to tower built on top
[*]Wasp nest - poisons nearby enemies
[*]Golden veil - 3x gold gain to mine built here
[*]Gnome engineer - choose and build level 5 top tower
[*]Priest - towers of chosen kind gain 3 levels
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]First levels music (not in loop now)
[*]Crash after selecting share damage cards
[*]Build tower SFX
[*]Tower clicking accuracy
[*]Changed graphics of Vulcan turret
[*]Changed graphics of swamp platforms
[*]Overtime damage indicator
[*]Skill tree respec behaviour
[*]Damage bonus after tower upgrade
[*]Improved scene lighting (SSAO -> HBAO)
[/list]

tags.bug: - First levels music (not in loop now)
- Crash after selecting share damage cards

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.10
notes.content:
[h3]News[/h3]
[list]
[*]MacOS support (Apple M1 and later)
[*]Mousewheel reverse option
[*]When a player leave game early, he will receive some XP
[*]New hints after start game
[*]New boss special behaviour
[*]Some visual improvements
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Deathray sound is less annoying
[*]Adjusted some sounds
[*]Sand platform tower placement
[*]Some VFXs changed
[*]Some minor bugs fixed
[/list]

tags.feature: When a player leave game early, he will receive some XP

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.9
notes.content:
[h3]News[/h3]
[list]
[*]New heroes are playable (Druid and Tesla), player can combine two heroes on map
[*]Crytals now adds hero power instead attack count
[*]Enabled tower targeting switch (player can choose between near, first, slow, strong and weaks targets)
[*]Enabled tower selling
[*]Respec button (player can forget skill and gain half XP value)
[*]Changed two cards Goldmine and Reroll, goldmine is default now
[*]Next 10 epic cards are functional now (16 in total)
[*]Added ingame tooltips
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Cursor behaviour
[*]Throwing weapon aim prediction
[*]Frozen card deck after epic card draw
[*]Some control changes (escape, selecting towers)
[*]Towers show range circle correctly
[*]Some tower and hero balancing
[*]Some visual improvements
[*]Few more bugs fixed
[/list]

Respec button (player can forget skill and gain half XP value)
